function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Here’s a quick snapshot of the **next big festival happening in the United States**—the **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival**. It’s one of the country’s most celebrated multi‑day music events, and it’s coming up very soon. --- ## Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival **Dates:** **June 28 – 30, 2024** **Location:** **Manchester, Tennessee** (Bonnaroo Ranch, 1 Bonnaroo Rd., Manchester, TN 37132) **Website:** [bonnaroo.com](https://www.bonnaroo.com) ### What to Expect | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Line‑up** | Headliners include **The Strokes, The Killers, and The 1975** (plus a rotating roster of indie, hip‑hop, electronic, and world‑music acts). | | **Stages** | 7 main stages + 2 “Bonnaroo‑only” stages (e.g., the “Bonnaroo Stage” for emerging artists). | | **Activities** | • Art installations & interactive exhibits
• Food trucks & gourmet food vendors
• Outdoor cinema & live‑action theater
• Yoga & wellness workshops
• “Bonnaroo” themed scavenger hunts | | **Camping** | • 3‑day “Bonnaroo” camping (all‑inclusive), 2‑day “Bonnaroo” camping, and “Bonnaroo” “B‑camp” (budget‑friendly). | | **Tickets** | • 3‑day general admission: $499 (early‑bird $449)
• 2‑day passes: $349 (early‑bird $319)
• VIP & “B‑camp” options available | | **Weather** | Expect mild to warm temperatures (mid‑70s°F / 21–24 °C) with a chance of afternoon showers. Check the local forecast a week before. | ### Why It’s Worth Your Time - **Diverse Music**: From rock & indie to hip‑hop, electronic, and global sounds. - **Community Vibe**: Known for its welcoming, inclusive atmosphere. - **Unique Experiences**: Art, food, and wellness activities that go beyond the music. - **Scenic Setting**: The festival grounds are nestled in the beautiful Tennessee countryside, offering a natural escape from city life. --- ## Quick Planning Checklist | Item | Action | |------|--------| | **Buy Tickets** | Purchase early‑bird tickets via the official site to lock in the best price. | | **Arrange Travel** | Manchester is ~2 hrs from Nashville, ~3 hrs from Knoxville, and ~4 hrs from Atlanta. Consider renting a van or carpooling. | | **Pack Essentials** | Comfortable shoes, rain jacket, reusable water bottle, sunscreen, portable charger, and a small backpack. | | **Check Weather** | Use a reliable weather app (e.g., Weather.com or the Open‑Meteo API) a week before to adjust your gear. | | **Plan Camping** | Reserve your campsite early; the “B‑camp” option is cheaper but has fewer amenities. | --- ### Other Upcoming Festivals (in case Bonnaroo isn’t your style) | Festival | Dates | Location | Highlights | |----------|-------|----------|------------| | **Lollapalooza** | Aug 9‑11, 2024 | Chicago, IL | Massive lineup, art installations, and a “Lollapalooza” food hall. | | **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | Apr 27‑May 5, 2024 | New Orleans, LA | Jazz, blues, and world music with a focus on local culture. | | **South by Southwest (SXSW)** | Mar 8‑17, 2024 | Austin, TX | Music, film, and interactive media; great for networking. | | **Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC)** | May 18‑20, 2024 | Las Vegas, NV | World‑class EDM, neon lights, and themed stages. | --- #### Need More Details? - **Line‑up updates**: Check the official Bonnaroo site or their social media feeds. - **Travel & lodging**: Look into nearby hotels or Airbnb options if you’re not camping. - **COVID‑19 policies**: As of now, no mask mandates, but keep an eye on local guidelines. Enjoy the music, the art, and the community spirit! 🎶🌿
